title: Live E2E: a cold live-backend install crashes in npm (`Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')`) on next.1 and next.2 alike; the lane is green only from its cache
body:
Filing gate ①: a measured CI defect. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 4 (`session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`), which found it while landing objectstack-ai/objectui#12648 (objectui#12626, the `@objectstack/*` `next.2` bump). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

reach: every PR that changes `e2e/live/ci/backend.env` or otherwise misses the `live-backend-*` cache key. The `Live E2E (informational)` lane is informational, so it blocks no merge, but on a cache miss it tests nothing.

## Measured

- **On CI:** `Live E2E (informational)` on PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12648, head `371c3a2`, run `38887101214`, job `116927385035`.
  - The cache misses (`live-backend-Linux-3e640c78…`, new pins), so `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` runs a fresh `npm install --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error` in the rewritten showcase app.
  - It dies after 12 s with `npm error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')`.
  - No spec ran, and no artifact was uploaded.
- **Reproduced locally**, with npm 10.9.4 on node 22.22.0, using the same rewrite as `start-backend.sh` (every `@objectstack/*` dependency set to the pin, and `devDependencies` set to `@objectstack/cli` only):
  - `18.0.0-next.2` with the showcase at `e5136ff10f` (the `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.2` tag): exit 1, the same error.
  - **CONTROL**, `18.0.0-next.1` with the showcase at `0c52e43` (the `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.1` tag, the pin `main` carries today): exit 1, the same error.

  So it is not the `next.2` bump. The other open PRs show the lane green (objectstack-ai/objectui#12636, #12637, #12644) because the step reuses the cached backend (`pins unchanged … reusing`), and never installs.
- **The stack:** `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')` at `#loadPeerSet` (`@npmcli/arborist/lib/arborist/build-ideal-tree.js:1289`), under `idealTree:node_modules/@objectstack/cli`. The last packument fetched before it was `canvas`. That is npm's peer-set resolution failing on the published `@objectstack/cli` dependency graph as the registry resolves it today.
- **A probe, not a fix:** the same `next.2` install with `--legacy-peer-deps` exits 0 (506 packages, `node_modules/.bin/objectstack` present). Whether the backend then boots and the allowlist passes was not measured.

## Ask

- Make the cold install succeed and pin it, rather than rely on the cache: `--legacy-peer-deps` in `start-backend.sh`, or the peer fix upstream in `@objectstack/cli`'s manifest. Choose by measuring the backend boot and the allowlist run.
- Until then, a green `Live E2E` on a PR that moves `backend.env` means nothing, and a red one there is this card, not the PR.
